entries.text: Idea: adding a heavy-duty thermal deflector plate to the nose of the little dart
Read "Parker Solar Probe - NASA Science": that little probe flies right through the sun's corona at four hundred thousand miles an hour!
searching the wire for parker solar probe telemetry and thermal shield designs
entries.why: i need to see how the pros handle star-melting heat before the little dart flies past anything hot

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Solar probes and heat shields!"
Idea: install a gravity-curve compensator toggle next to the primary thruster switch on the dashboard.

searching deep space network transponder schematics on the comms tower terminal
